mapper.select: SELECT t.tent_id::text AS "id", t.opp_id AS "opportunityId", t.dev_id AS "developerId", t.tent_stat_cd AS "status", o.opp_stat_cd AS "opportunityStatus", t.proc_dttm AS "processedAt" FROM tb_sl_tent_asgn t JOIN tb_sl_opp o ON o.opp_id=t.opp_id WHERE t.tent_id=CAST(#{id} AS numeric)
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_sl_tent_asgn SET tent_stat_cd='REL',proc_dttm=#{now},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE tent_id=CAST(#{id} AS numeric) AND opp_id=#{opportunityId} AND tent_stat_cd='ACT'
UPDATE tb_sl_opp SET mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE opp_id=#{opportunityId}
